code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,6.5,'cold chamber on skid with roof solar rails',ha='center',fontsize=11)
# walls
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,1.5),6,4,color='lightblue',ec='black',lw=1.5))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,1.0),6,0.5,color='gray',ec='black',lw=1.5))
ax.text(5,1.25,'steel skid base',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# door
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4,1.5),2,3,color='white',ec='black',lw=1.5))
ax.text(5,3.2,'800 door\n+ seals',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# racks crates
for x in [2.3,6.9]:
    for y in [1.8,2.5,3.2,3.9,4.6]:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,y),0.8,0.5,color='orange',ec='black'))
ax.text(2.7,5.4,'racks + crates',fontsize=8,ha='center')
ax.text(6.5,5.4,'racks + crates',fontsize=8,ha='center')
ax.text(5,2.0,'aisle',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# roof + solar
ax.plot([1.5,8.5],[5.5,5.9],'k-',lw=2)
ax.plot([2,8],[5.9,6.3],'b-',lw=3)
ax.text(6.5,6.2,'solar rails',fontsize=8)
# anchors
for x in [2,8]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[0.4,1.0],'k-',lw=1.5)
    ax.plot([x-0.3,x+0.3],[0.4,0.4],'k-',lw=2)
ax.text(5,0.15,'ground anchors',ha='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=110); print('saved')
